The case is blue with the PS4 logo at the top left.
The cover art features Geralt of Rivia with a sword and a dagger.
The PEGI 18 rating is visible in the bottom left corner.
The text 'CD PROJECT RED' is visible at the bottom right.
The background shows a red couch and a wall with 'Prezin Gadgets' signage.
The case appears to be in good condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The seller's watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI PREZIN GADGETS' is overlaid on both photos.

risks.risk: The game may be a digital copy or a pirated version, not a physical disc.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the case showing the barcode and serial number, or a video of the game being inserted into a PS4 and launched.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially pirated or non-functional

risks.risk: The game disc may be damaged or missing.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the disc inside the case, showing no scratches or damage.

risks.risk: The game may be region-locked or not compatible with the buyer's PS4 region.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the case showing the region code or a video of the game being played on a PS4 in the buyer's region.
